task: One flag in Production is enabled and serving the value "maintenance". Find it and turn it off in Production. Leave every other flag alone.
finalText: DONE: In Production (environment id 93), `search_v2` was the only enabled flag serving "maintenance"; it is now disabled and every other flag is unchanged.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag --help; flagsmith feature update --help 2>&1 | head -60
flagsmith config; flagsmith flag list -e [env-8aee556e47c7680e] --json | jq '.'
flagsmith flag disable search_v2 -e [env-8aee556e47c7680e]; echo "---"; flagsmith flag list -e [env-8aee556e47c7680e] --json | jq '.[] | {feature, enabled, value}'
flagsmith flag disable search_v2 -e [env-8aee556e47c7680e] --yes; echo "---"; flagsmith flag list -e [env-8aee556e47c7680e] --json | jq '.[] | {feature, enabled, value}'
